aiResearchSummary.text: Palitronica is researching systems and methods for side-channel monitoring of processors and local networks, as described in titles such as 'Systems and methods for side-channel monitoring of a processor connected to a communication network' and 'Systems and methods for side-channel monitoring of a local network.' Their work includes non-intrusive program tracing using power consumption, electromagnetic emission, and acoustic emanation to monitor device and control processor activity. These efforts focus on cyber-protection for critical infrastructure.
